description: Azure XML is a shared library providing the XmlReader and XmlWriter abstractions used across Azure SDK for Java client libraries to serialize and deserialize XML payloads. It offers a lightweight, dependency-minimized alternative to full XML data-binding frameworks, backed by an internal StAX-based implementation.

Azure XML is a shared library providing the XmlReader and XmlWriter abstractions used across Azure SDK for Java client libraries to serialize and deserialize XML payloads. It offers a lightweight, dependency-minimized alternative to full XML data-binding frameworks, backed by an internal StAX-based implementation.
